title: API Rate Limits and Quotas
content:
# API Rate Limits

SuperDocs provides developer APIs for document synchronization. On the Pro plan, users are allocated 10,000 API calls per month. Once this threshold is reached, requests return HTTP 429.

title: Configuring Webhooks and REST Endpoints
content:
# Webhook Setup

To ensure uninterrupted delivery, monitor your quota. The Pro plan allows 10,000 API calls per month across all endpoints. Ensure your client handles rate-limiting headers.

title: Managing Your Subscription and Payment Methods
content:
# Subscription Management

To update credit cards or upgrade tiers, go to Settings > Billing > Plans and select your desired option. Invoices are generated on the first of every month.

screenshots.caption: The Plans screen under Billing settings

title: Upgrading and Downgrading Workspace Accounts
content:
# Workspace Tier Adjustments

Account administrators can change tiers anytime. Navigate to the Plans section inside Billing settings to review tier comparisons.

title: Legacy Tier Support and SLA Details
content:
# Legacy Account Features

Customers enrolled in Legacy Pro retain full audit logging capabilities. Priority support tickets are responded to within four hours during business days.

screenshots.caption: Legacy Pro tier badge shown on account header

title: Audit Logging Configuration
content:
# Audit Log Export

Audit trails capture all user edits and document exports. This feature requires Legacy Pro or Enterprise tier subscription.

title: Exporting Workspace Data to CSV
content:
# Bulk Data Export

To export historical records, administrators must run export script and download row by row from the server console. This generates discrete CSV summaries.

title: Archiving Inactive Projects
content:
# Project Archival

Before archiving a project, perform a manual batch export of all attached assets. Ensure all team members have completed their pending reviews.

title: Attaching Files to Documents
content:
# File Attachments

SuperDocs supports PDF and image attachments in markdown documents. Each individual file upload size is capped at 5 MB maximum.

title: Collaborative Asset Storage
content:
# Asset Storage Quotas

Uploaded media files are stored securely in cloud storage. Please ensure files do not exceed the 5 MB limit per document attachment.

title: API SDK Integration Guide
content:
# SDK Integration

Initialize the client with your secret API key. Under the standard Pro tier, your application can execute 10,000 API calls per month before throttling occurs.

title: Annual Billing and Invoice History
content:
# Invoice Retrieval

To view past receipts, navigate to Settings > Billing > Plans. You can download PDF statements for tax filing purposes.

screenshots.caption: Download receipts in Billing navigation tab

title: Feature Matrix Across Membership Tiers
content:
# Feature Matrix

Review available features across account tiers. Automated webhook dispatch and custom SAML SSO are supported on Legacy Pro accounts.

title: Batch Reporting Workflows
content:
# Batch Report Generation

To export weekly analytics logs, administrators must execute manual batch export procedures across individual department views.

title: Embedding Image Diagrams in Technical Specs
content:
# Architecture Diagrams

Architects can embed high-resolution PNG schematics into markdown specs. Keep in mind that 5 MB is the maximum upload size allowed.

title: Markdown Keyboard Shortcuts
content:
# Keyboard Shortcuts

Speed up editing with standard keybindings. Press Cmd+B for bold, Cmd+I for italics, and Cmd+K to insert hyperlinks.

title: Inviting Team Members to Workspaces
content:
# Workspace Collaboration

Invite team members by email address. You can assign Viewer, Editor, or Admin roles to manage permissions effectively.

title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
content:
# Two-Factor Authentication

Enhance account security by enabling TOTP-based 2FA. Scan the QR code using Google Authenticator or 1Password.

title: Custom Domain Configuration
content:
# Custom Domains

Point your CNAME record to domains.superdocs.app. SSL certificates are provisioned automatically via Let's Encrypt within 15 minutes.

title: Document Version History and Rollback
content:
# Version History

SuperDocs tracks every keystroke with timestamped revisions. You can preview past versions and restore previous drafts with one click.

title: Syntax Highlighting for Code Blocks
content:
# Code Highlighting

Code blocks support syntax highlighting for over 40 programming languages including TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go.

title: Dark Mode and Custom Theme Preferences
content:
# Theme Preferences

Switch between light, dark, and system theme modes in user preferences. Themes use high-contrast HSL color palettes.

title: Accelerating Team Revenue Growth
content:
# Revenue Growth Strategy

Driving sustained growth requires cross-functional alignment. Focus on user onboarding metrics and time-to-first-document to accelerate customer satisfaction.

title: Browser Memory Limits and Performance Tuning
content:
# Browser Memory Considerations

When editing huge documents containing hundreds of tables, client memory limit constraints in Chrome may impact responsiveness. Split large books into chapters.

title: Subscribing to Release Notes and Email Digests
content:
# Email Newsletter

Stay informed on weekly updates by subscribing to our product newsletter. You can unsubscribe anytime via the link in the footer.

title: Structuring Organization Hierarchies
content:
# Organization Structure

Design your workspace departments to reflect real company structure. Sub-teams allow departmental autonomy without cluttering root navigation.

title: Custom Enterprise Contract Provisions
content:
# Enterprise Custom Terms

For enterprise customers, pricing is subject to change based on custom MSA negotiation. Contact sales for tier details and customized service level agreements.

title: Experimental Beta Features Rollout
content:
# Experimental Workflows

This article outlines an experimental beta feature for real-time document sync. Instructions and screens may vary depending on rollout phase across regions.

title: General Export Quota Policies
content:
# Export Quotas Overview

Export operations consume system resources and are governed by general export limit policies. Consult your account dashboard for current quota metrics.

This draft outlines migration steps for the upcoming editor overhaul. Verification is pending engineering signoff.

content:
# Legacy Protocols

Support for older synchronization protocols is under review. Custom terms apply to legacy accounts requesting prolonged protocol uptime.
